text: Open the Ironic Menu from the button on the top menu bar. It is the hub for this mod's custom features - each button opens that feature's panel.

Lists every historical general that can join Cao Cao, Sun Jian, Sun Ce or Liu Bei. Each row shows the general, the years they may arrive (the join window), and a status - Not yet (grey) means not spawned, In world (green) means they have joined, Fallen (red) means they have died. Click a joined general's row to select and zoom the camera to them on the map.

Each general has an eligibility window, e.g. 192 - 198 AD. During those years there is a chance each turn that the general joins your faction. Romance-only characters appear only in Romance mode. Generals also join AI factions, so their status can change without you doing anything.
Ironic mod - custom UI and campaign features. Built on Total War: THREE KINGDOMS.
